meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: Claude 会帮你接入 Mattermost 机器人频道：先查找本机已有的健康服务器，没有就提议装一个本地评测服务器，再设置 SiteURL、复制适配器、创建并认证机器人，接通私聊、频道、话题、文件和审批卡片。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Mattermost 频道时接管。它会先探测本机服务器，再问你是复用已有服务器、输入其他 URL，还是创建本地评测服务器。

say.text: 帮我添加 Mattermost 频道
say.note: 先探测本机有没有可用的服务器

say.text: 用 http://localhost:8065 这个服务器
say.note: 跳过探测，直接采用你给的地址

say.text: 创建一个本地评测服务器

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Mattermost bot channel: it looks for an existing healthy local server, else offers a local evaluation server, then sets SiteURL, copies the adapter, creates and authenticates a bot, and wires DMs, channels, files and approval cards.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to add a Mattermost channel to NanoClaw; it probes for a local server, then asks whether to reuse it, enter another URL, or create a local evaluation server.

say_en.note: Probes for an existing local server first
Skips discovery and uses your URL
Runs Mattermost and PostgreSQL in Docker; needs approval
